notes.title: New update: version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello community! Thank you for playing Redd's Runaway! We are hearing your feedback and prepared a new update, the version 1.0.2:

Version 1.0.2
- Typos fixed in Spanish translation
- Platform colors changed
- Amulet timer updated
- Limit barrier removed from game; limit system is kept intact, however

Thank you for your support!
